finding: Slovak turnover outlook fell while euro area expectations rose
bullets: A net 6.75% of Slovak firms (n=228) expected turnover to increase, down 14.15 pp from two waves earlier, while the euro area rose to a net 25.88% — widening the SK–EA gap to 19.1 pp, signalling weaker Slovak competitiveness.

Slovak fixed investment expectations rose to a net 14.67% (n=228), up 3.88 pp from two waves earlier, outpacing the euro area's net 9.45% and reversing the relative positions of the two regions — suggesting catch-up potential.

Euro area and German turnover outlooks both improved from two waves earlier, reaching net 25.88% and net 19.08% respectively, confirming Slovakia as the regional outlier on turnover pessimism — highlighting structural challenges.
